description: In openLCA, calculate Life Cycle Impact Assessment (LCIA) results for an electricity product system. If no database or product system exists, first create a database, import ~/LCA_Imports/uslci_database.zip, and create a product system from an electricity process. Then run a calculation with any available impact assessment method and view the results showing impact categories. Export the results to ~/LCA_Results/. LCIA methods may be available at ~/LCA_Imports/lcia_methods.zip for import.
